name: Ridge: Offline Walking Maps
subtitle: Plan, explore & preview in 3D

listing.description:
Get a feel for the walk before you go. Ridge brings your route onto 3D terrain, so you can see the climbs, follow a ridgeline and explore what lies ahead.

EXPLORE THE SHAPE OF THE LAND
Browse the included UK overview and explore detailed offline terrain in Eryri, the Lake District, Peak District, and Chilterns & Thames Valley. Zoom from the overhead map into 3D and move around the landscape on iPhone or iPad. Available terrain and its level of detail vary by area.

PLAN YOUR OWN ROUTE
Add and edit waypoints, follow mapped walking paths or sketch a direct line. Inspect the elevation profile, distance, ascent and descent. Undo changes, reverse a route or add a return to the start. Your routes save locally in your library.

FLY THROUGH THE JOURNEY
Preview your route with a forward-moving, banked flight over the terrain. Pause or scrub through the journey and see where you are on its elevation profile. Flight previews use the included offline terrain.

GET READY TO GO
Open Before you go to set a walking pace, add breaks and estimate your finish time. Review the route's legs, check saved-map coverage and keep a packing checklist and route notes. Time and elevation figures are planning estimates, with gaps shown where data is incomplete.

BRING YOUR GPX FILES
Import a GPX route or track from Files, keep its separate sections and export routes through the system share sheet. Search, sort and favourite your saved routes.

MADE FOR OFFLINE PLANNING
The UK overview plus detailed maps and walking paths for Eryri, the Lake District, Peak District, and Chilterns & Thames Valley are included with the app. Plan and preview routes in these areas without a separate map download or internet connection. Detailed coverage is limited to the included areas and varies along their edges; the map shows gaps where terrain is unavailable. No Ridge account is required, and there are no ads or behavioural analytics.

FREE DURING EARLY ACCESS
The current features are free during early access. Pricing may change in future versions. Feedback is welcome and optional.

Ridge is a route-planning and terrain-preview tool. It does not provide live turn-by-turn navigation. Mapped paths do not establish access rights or current ground conditions; check your route, weather and equipment before setting out.
listing.promotionalText: Free during early access. Explore Eryri, the Lakes, the Peaks and the Chilterns with included offline maps, route planning and 3D flight previews.

reviewNotes:
Ridge 1.0 (4) — offline starter release

No sign-in or purchase is required. No separate map download is needed. The UK overview and detailed terrain / walking paths for Eryri, Lake District, Peak District, and Chilterns & Thames Valley are included with the app. Coverage gaps are shown on the map. Apple-hosted downloads are disabled in this release and no managed asset pack approval is needed for its included maps.

Suggested review:
1. Complete or skip the first-open walkthrough.
2. On Explore, zoom into clear terrain in one of the four included areas. The 2D map transitions to 3D. You can do this without network connectivity.
3. Tap Plan your route and add waypoints. Review distance, elevation, ascent and descent. Finish editing; the route saves in Routes.
4. Preview the route's flight; pause and scrub, then return to editing.
5. Open Before you go for walking pace, breaks, finish-time estimates, notes and a packing checklist.
6. Reopen the saved route, import a GPX from Files and export through the system share sheet.
7. Settings lists included maps and map/data credits. Removing downloaded maps preserves included maps and saved routes.

This is a planning and terrain-preview app, without live turn-by-turn navigation or background location tracking. Location access is optional. The current features are free during early access and feedback is optional. The included map data uses the same stable section identities as the future download backend; enabling additional coverage later will be an app update.
